events.text: Lenin Peak was renamed qulla‘i Abûalî ibni Sino in July 2006.
events.subject: self
events.quote: renamed қуллаи Абӯалӣ ибни Сино ( qulla‘i Abûalî ibni Sino ) in July 2006

events.text: It was thought to be the highest point in the Pamirs in Tajikistan until 1933.
events.subject: self
events.quote: It was thought to be the highest point in the Pamirs in Tajikistan until 1933

events.text: The peak was discovered and originally named Mount Kaufmann after Konstantin Kaufman.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The peak was discovered in 1871 and originally named Mount Kaufmann

events.text: The mountain was renamed Lenin Peak after Vladimir Lenin.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1928 , the mountain was renamed Lenin Peak

events.text: In Tajikistan the peak was renamed again, to Qullai Abuali ibni Sino.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the peak was renamed again in July 2006

events.text: Kyrgyz president Almazbek Atambayev called for renaming the peak Manas Peak.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in October 2017 , Kyrgyz president Almazbek Atambayev called for renaming the peak Manas Peak

events.text: Alexei Pavlovich Fedchenko discovered the Trans-Alai Range and its main peak.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Scientific expeditions to the Alai Mountains began in 1871 , when Alexei Pavlovich Fedchenko discovered the Trans-Alai ( Zaalayskiy ) Range and its main peak

events.text: The expedition of Nikolai Leopoldovich Korzhenevskiy came nearest to the base of the future Lenin Peak.
events.subject: self
events.quote: came nearest to the base of the future Lenin Peak in the early 20th century

events.text: Three mountaineers made the first attempt to reach the highest point of the Trans-Alai Range.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In September 1928 , three mountaineers -the Germans and Karl Wien , and the Austrian - from the Soviet-German scientific expedition , made the first attempt to reach the highest point of the Trans-Alai Range

events.text: They started climbing from the saddle along the NE Ridge and reached the summit.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On September 25 , 1928 they started climbing from the saddle along the NE Ridge and at 15.30 they reached the summit

events.text: On September 8 , 1934 , Kasian Chernuha , Vitaly Abalakov and Ivan Lukin reached the summit.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On September 8 , 1934 , at 16:20 Kasian Chernuha , Vitaly Abalakov and Ivan Lukin , three members of a Soviet expedition , reached the summit

events.text: The third ascent was in 1937 , when eight Soviet climbers under the direction of Lev Barkhash reached the summit.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1937 , when eight Soviet climbers under the direction of Lev Barkhash reached the summit

events.text: On August 14 , 1950 , twelve climbers under the direction of Vladimir Racek reached the summit for the fourth time.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On August 14 , 1950 , twelve climbers

events.text: The classic route was first climbed in 1954 by the team of Soviet climbers under the direction of V . Kovalev.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The route which now is known as the classic route , via the Razdelnaya Peak and NW Ridge , was first climbed in 1954

events.text: In 1960 , a group of eight Soviet climbers made a successful direct climb along the North Face.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1960 , a group of eight Soviet climbers made a successful direct climb along the North Face ( 15.08.1960 )

events.text: In 1974 , an entire team of eight female climbers died high on the mountain in a storm.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1974 , an entire team of eight female climbers died high on the mountain in a storm

events.text: The first high-speed ascent of Lenin Peak was completed in 1987.
events.subject: self
events.object: first high-speed ascent of Lenin Peak
events.quote: The first high-speed ascent of Lenin Peak was completed in 1987

events.text: Under the leadership of Leonid Troshchinenko the team made the first winter ascent of Lenin Peak in 1988.
events.subject: self
events.object: first winter ascent of Lenin Peak
events.quote: made the first winter ascent of Lenin Peak in 1988

events.text: The first solo ascent was achieved by Anatoli Boukreev.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1987 The first solo ascent was achieved by the great high altitude mountaineer Anatoli Boukreev

events.text: An avalanche triggered by an earthquake killed 43 climbers.
events.subject: self
events.quote: An avalanche triggered by an earthquake killed 43 climbers in 1990
